title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence

summary: The UK government has responded to the House of Lords Select Committee's report on Artificial Intelligence, acknowledging the need for action to ensure AI brings benefits without compromising safety and security. title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
